transcript: We watched you last night. I want to hire you to Meridian. There's the rest of it, said Katori. Then her hand was empty again. Done, Katori said. She walked on ahead, and Callie stood for a second in the middle of the road with the flat gray country going north in front of her and then went after her and did not ask the next question because she had a strong sense that the answer to it was waiting for her somewhere up the road regardless of whether she asked.
